page_note: ACEA报告第18页：正文讨论2024年欧盟商用车按动力源的注册份额，下方为Figure 5单面板百分比堆叠柱状图（Vans/Trucks/Buses），数值以带指示箭头的深色标签框标出。

heading.title: New commercial vehicles registrations by power source

components.evidence: each of the Vans, Trucks, Buses bars is built of Petrol/Diesel/ECV/HEV/Others segments
all three bars top out at the 100 tick and the axis ends at 100 with '% SHARE'
'Petrol  Diesel  Electrically chargeable vehicle (ECV) ...' row sits between the caption and the plot
boxed labels 'Diesel, 84.5%', 'ECV, 18.5%' drawn on top of their segments
'Others, 1.5%', 'Others, 2.6%', 'Others, 8.5%' boxes sit above the 100 line with pointer arrows
labels for the thin Others and HEV bands are pushed above the plot and stacked ('Others, 1.5%' over 'HEv, 2%')
faint horizontal rules at 20, 40, 60, 80, 100; no vertical rules in the panel
'% SHARE' printed above the 100 tick at the top-left of the plot
axis ticks are bare 0-100; the scale word appears only as '% SHARE' above the axis

new_components.name: series_name_inside_value_label
new_components.evidence: labels read 'Diesel, 84.5%', 'ECV, 6.1%', 'HEv, 2%' — series name and value in one box
new_components.why_it_matters: 系列名写在数值标签里，且用缩写（ECV、HEv）而非图例全名，取值时必须把标签文字与图例项对应起来。

new_components.name: pointer_arrow_label_box
new_components.evidence: each dark rounded label box has a small downward arrow tip touching its own segment
new_components.why_it_matters: 箭头是标签与段的唯一归属线索；箭头方向决定该数值属于哪一段而不是相邻段。

new_components.name: unlabeled_minor_segments
new_components.evidence: Trucks Petrol/HEV and Buses Petrol segments carry no printed value while others do
new_components.why_it_matters: 同一图内部分段无数值，只能靠像素读数，且其厚度不足一格（20%）刻度，无法在5%容差内读出。

spot_checks.mark: the Vans HEV segment, labelled 'HEv, 2%' above the plot
the Trucks Others segment, labelled above the 100 line

difficulty_notes: 十个被评分值全部印在图上，读数不是瓶颈；难点是定位。每个值都需要两把钥匙（车型 Vans/Trucks/Buses 加动力源），而图上只有 'Diesel, 84.5%' 这类合并文本，车型只写在类别轴上，解析器很容易把三组标签堆成一串而丢掉列归属。此外标签用缩写 'ECV'、'HEv' 而图例写作 'Electrically chargeable vehicle (ECV)'、'Hybrid electric vehicle (HEV)'，检索时两套名称不一致；'6'（Vans Petrol）与 '6.1'（Vans ECV）、'2'（Vans HEV）与 '2.3'、'2.6' 数字近似，缺了钥匙就无法唯一定位。

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 series_name_inside_value_label（数值标签内含系列名且用缩写）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标签样式字段：label_text_template 增加 '{series_abbrev}, {value}{unit}' 模式，并允许 legend 名与标签缩写不一致
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 标签文本是否携带系列名（纯数值 vs 名称+数值 vs 缩写名+数值）对定位准确率的影响

suggestions.what_to_add: value_label_outside 与 thin_segment_label 的组合：细段标签溢出到绘图区上方并带指示箭头
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式维度 value-label placement：新增 'overflow_above_plot_with_leader' 取值，触发条件为段高小于阈值
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 细段（<3% 高度）标签外移+引线 vs 直接省略，两种条件下该段取值可得率

suggestions.what_to_add: axis_title_above_axis 承载单位（'% SHARE' 置于顶端刻度之上）
suggestions.where_to_change: 标题记录字段：unit 与其 placement 独立于 title/subtitle，可取 'above_top_tick'
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位位置（轴上方 / 轴标题旁 / 副标题）三种条件下单位复原率

suggestions.what_to_add: new_components 的 unlabeled_minor_segments：同图内部分段无数值标签
suggestions.where_to_change: 记录字段：per-mark label_printed 布尔，导出时区分“印出”与“需读像素”
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 同一图内混合“已印数值段”与“未印数值段”时，未印段的可达精度单列一行
